title: These are Very small and thin, only holds 1/3 of a cup.
text:
These are Very small and thin, only holds 1/3 of a cup.. You do not only need these only for a Air Fryer.

There silicone Very small thin cups for baking, for making small Quiches , Very small bite size cupcakes etc.
I like cupcake cups for putting in muffin dough into the bottom, and filling with apples, jams nuts, pesto , spinach with goodies inside but these are too small to add a egg etc.
Makes a nice dessert, or rolls for dinner. You can make little healthy goodies in these.
Although I’m Very disappointed at the size of these.
They only hold 1/3 of a cup which I think is ridiculous, unless your making something for toddlers, but still too small for
Hors D’oeuvres.

Before using, brush a little Avocado oil inside. i have other Silicone cups that are larger and more useful.

There BPA free, but I think All silicone is!

The OXO Better Guarantee: If you experience an issue with your OXO product, get in touch with us for a repair or replacement. We’re grateful for the opportunity to learn from your experience, and we’ll make it better.
description: The OXO good grips silicone Air fryer Cups is the perfect companion to any air fryer. The easy-to-clean silicone cups are the perfect size for making egg bites, and have a fill line to ensure consistency every time. And they’re not just for savory treats! You can make cupcakes, too, either in the air fryer or in your oven – no need for a muffin tin. These BPA-free Cups have handy tabs and a smooth interior for effortless food release, and flip inside out for easy cleaning. Set of six Cups.
